lede: Smyrna celebrates Christmas with a long-running town parade on Lowry Street, a tree lighting at the Smyrna Train Depot and a Christmas tea at the Historic Sam Davis Home.
celebrates: The Town of Smyrna starts its season with the Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony at the Smyrna Train Depot on Front Street, with an all-kids sing-along and photos with Santa and Ms. Claus. The Smyrna Christmas Parade follows on the first Sunday in December on Lowry Street, with floats, bands, performers and community groups, and families bring canned goods for the food drive. The Historic Sam Davis Home and Museum adds a Christmas Tea Party with afternoon tea and a visit to the house in its holiday decorations, so a Smyrna weekend can mix the parade, the tea and a train depot tree.
lastyear: On Sunday, December 7, 2025, Smyrna held its 50th annual Christmas Parade and Food Drive at 2 pm. The Town of Smyrna's Instagram said the parade traveled northbound on Lowry Street from Mayfield Drive to Nolan Drive through the heart of town. The fire department's post reminded families to bring canned goods, and noted road closures began at 9 am, with more closures along Lowry Street starting at 1:30 pm.
facts: The 2026 Christmas parade is the 51st Smyrna Christmas Parade, and the town gave it the theme A Star-Spangled Christmas: Celebrating America's 250th. The Historic Sam Davis Home and Museum is at 1399 Sam Davis Road. Its Christmas Tea Party is held on the first Saturday in December, and tickets are sold through the museum's own website. The Smyrna Train Depot at 98 Front Street hosts the town's Christmas tree lighting, which this year took place on Tuesday, November 24.
trains: The Smyrna Train Depot on Front Street is where the town lights its Christmas tree, so trains are part of the local holiday picture. faq: When is the Smyrna Christmas Parade in 2026?

The Town of Smyrna holds the 51st Smyrna Christmas Parade on Sunday, December 6, 2026, at 2 pm on Lowry Street in Downtown Smyrna. The town lists it as free to attend and asks families to follow its social media for weather changes.
Where is the Smyrna Christmas tree lighting?

The town lights its tree at the Smyrna Train Depot, 98 Front Street. The 2026 ceremony was held on Tuesday, November 24, from 6 to 8 pm, with an all-kids sing-along and photos with Santa and Ms. Claus, so it has already passed this year. The parade on December 6 is the next town event.
What Christmas events are at the Sam Davis Home?

The Historic Sam Davis Home and Museum holds a Christmas Tea Party on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 2 to 4 pm, with afternoon tea and a walk through the decorated house. Reservations are required and each guest needs a ticket.
Is there a Christmas food drive in Smyrna?

Yes. The 2025 parade was held together with a food drive, and the town asked families to bring canned goods to the parade. Check the Town of Smyrna's social media before December 6 to confirm what the town is collecting this year and where to drop items.
Where can we ride a Christmas train near Smyrna?

The Tennessee Central Railway Museum in Nashville runs Saturday excursions to Watertown and Lebanon and a December Santa Express. Open Rally's museum page for current dates, tickets and boarding details before you plan the drive, since seats on holiday trains tend to sell out in advance.
